verified_claims.claim: penipyridinone B (1) 分子式 C43H61NO8，HRESIMS m/z 720.4473 [M+H]+ 和 742.4292 [M+Na]+
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文第 3 页 2.1 节 / 第 12 页 3.5 节
verified_claims.evidence: m/z 720.4473 [M + H] and 742.4292 [M + Na], corresponding to a molecular formula C43H61NO8.

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 2 (11S-(−)-penilloid A) [α]20D −201.6 (c 0.16, MeOH)，化合物 3 (11R,14E-(+)-penilloid A) [α]20D +203.8 (c 0.18, MeOH)
化合物 2 14Z 构型由 Δδ(C14-C18) MeOH-d4 13.0 ppm 与 DMSO-d6 11.6 ppm 证实；化合物 3 14E 构型由 Δδ(C14-C18) 0.4 ppm 与 1.3 ppm 证实
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文第 7 页 Table 2 + 文中描述；第 8 页 Table 3 + 文中描述
verified_claims.evidence: the ΔδC14-C18 values in MeOH-d4 and DMSO-d6 were 13.0 and 11.6 ppm, respectively, indicating a 14Z-geometry for 2; the ΔδC14-C18 values of 0.4 ppm in MeOH-d4 and 1.3 ppm in DMSO-d6 indicated a 14E-geometry in 3
a positive OR value (+697.42) for 11R and a negative OR value (−697.60) for 11S

verified_claims.claim: Ac-DEVD-CHO (10 µM) 在 U251 和 U87MG 中显著降低 questiomycin A (9) 引起的 caspase-3 活化；在 U251 中显著降低 xanthocillin X (10) 引起的 caspase-3 活化（# p < 0.05），U87MG 中不显著
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文第 10 页 Figure 9 caption
verified_claims.evidence: However, Ac-DEVD-CHO only significantly reduced the enhancement of caspase-3 activity induced by xanthocillin X (10) in U251 cells (# p < 0.05)

verified_claims.claim: GA 液体培养基大规模培养：60 L，300 个 500 mL 锥形瓶，每瓶 200 mL GA 培养基，28 °C 180 rpm 4 天制种，静置室温 30 天
verified_claims.evidence: pure colony of strain ZZ1750 from the PDA medium slant was inoculated into 500 mL Erlenmeyer flasks, each containing 200 mL of GA liquid medium, then incubated at 28 ◦C for 4 days on a rotary shaker (180 rpm); seed broth (5 mL) was transferred into 200 mL GA liquid medium in a 500 mL Erlenmeyer flask, then incubated in static state at room temperature for 30 days. A total of 60 L culture (300 flasks)
